summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Defense to modify the financial literacy and preparedness survey for military members to identify their current financial literacy levels, preferred education methods, specific financial topics of interest, and barriers to participation, and to ensure better tracking and completion of financial readiness training.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly concerns the well-being and financial literacy of members of the Armed Forces, which falls under the broader umbrella of military affairs. It mandates improvements to financial literacy training and surveys within the Department of Defense, making it moderately central to military operations and personnel management.
